description: A structured onboarding journey for monetization leaders supporting live game revenue, offers, events, economy and player value.
roleMission: Grow sustainable player value through thoughtful monetization, healthy game economies and evidence-based experimentation.
operatingModel: Understand the player journey, game economy, offers, LiveOps cadence and commercial measures.
Partner with Product, Economy, Analytics and LiveOps to design and validate initiatives.
Use performance evidence and player guardrails to prioritize the next monetization opportunities.
journeyPrinciples: Understand the game, players, economy and commercial model.
Assess the monetization portfolio and performance.
Design and validate focused monetization opportunities.
Deliver a measurable initiative and plan sustainable growth.

60: Launched pilot or confirmed launch-ready initiative

phaseSuccessCriteria.30: Critical access is available; the manager understands the game, player journey, economy and commercial model; KPIs, tools and stakeholders are understood; a credible opportunity backlog exists.
phaseSuccessCriteria.60: One focused initiative is designed and validated; scope, audience, KPIs, guardrails and dependencies are clear; partners are aligned; the initiative is launched, piloted or ready for launch.
phaseSuccessCriteria.90: Initial commercial and player impact has been measured; clear learnings and recommendations exist; a prioritized six-month roadmap is in place; sustainable planning and performance routines are established.

stakeholderCategories: VIP, User Acquisition, Creative or Art
suggestedResources: Test post-mortems, pricing and segmentation documentation

weeks.title: Foundation and access
weeks.focus: Become operational and understand the organization and monetization environment.
outcomes: Required access is requested or completed
Initial understanding of teams, ownership and commercial planning
Priority introductions and recurring meetings are established
activities: Secure access to dashboards, economy tools, offer-management systems, Jira, Confluence, Slack and shared drives
Review the studio, portfolio and game-team structure
Understand ownership across Product, Economy, LiveOps, Analytics and Monetization
Review the roadmap and commercial calendar

weeks.title: Game, player and business immersion
weeks.focus: Understand the player journey, game loops and core commercial model.
outcomes: Initial understanding of player lifecycle and progression
Familiarity with monetization and engagement KPIs
Initial understanding of payer behavior and value segments
activities: Play the game and document the core player journey
Review progression, currencies, sinks, sources and purchase surfaces
Review revenue, ARPDAU, conversion, payer rate, ARPPU, purchase frequency and LTV
Review player segmentation, VIP behavior and initial hypotheses

weeks.title: Economy, offers and LiveOps
weeks.focus: Understand how the economy and commercial content work together.
outcomes: Initial map of currencies, resources, offers and LiveOps mechanics
Understanding of the current offer and event portfolio
Awareness of important economy and monetization dependencies
activities: Review currencies, sources, sinks and progression gates
Review bundles, subscriptions, passes, sales and promotional mechanics
Review the LiveOps calendar and event monetization
Understand offer creation, approval, configuration, QA, pricing and segmentation

weeks.title: Performance and decision-making
weeks.focus: Understand how monetization performance is analyzed and decisions are made.
outcomes: Main monetization dashboards and recurring analyses are understood
Commercial planning and decision workflows are mapped
Initial performance gaps and opportunity themes are documented
activities: Review revenue and offer-performance dashboards
Understand conversion, uplift, cannibalization and player impact
Review recent tests and post-mortems
Map commercial planning, decision points and slow workflows

weeks.title: First-month monetization assessment
weeks.focus: Consolidate learning into an initial assessment and opportunity backlog.
outcomes: First-month monetization assessment is complete
Strengths, risks and opportunity areas are documented
One focused initiative or analysis is selected
activities: Summarize the monetization portfolio and player segments
Identify performance, process and player-experience opportunities
Build an initial opportunity backlog
Select an opportunity and agree business goal and success metrics

weeks.title: Opportunity deep dive
outcomes: Opportunity and target audience are clearly defined
Baseline performance and player behavior are understood
Initial hypotheses are documented
activities: Define the business problem and opportunity
Review player and payer segments
Analyze performance and historical initiatives
Document economy implications, assumptions, risks and dependencies

weeks.title: Initiative design
weeks.focus: Turn the opportunity into a testable monetization concept.
outcomes: Initiative concept, audience and mechanics are defined
Success metrics and guardrails are established
Cross-functional feasibility is confirmed
activities: Define the target player segment
Design offer, feature, pricing, event or mechanic
Define primary KPIs and player-experience guardrails
Validate economy, technical, production and LiveOps feasibility

weeks.title: Cross-functional planning
outcomes: Scope, owners, dependencies and timeline are clear
Tracking and measurement plans are ready
Stakeholder alignment is secured
activities: Align with Product, Economy, Analytics, LiveOps, Production and Engineering
Define implementation and QA requirements
Confirm analytics events and reporting needs
Create launch, communication, monitoring and risk-mitigation plans

weeks.title: Launch readiness or pilot
weeks.focus: Launch the first initiative or complete launch readiness.
outcomes: Initiative is launched, piloted or ready for execution
Monitoring and decision criteria are established
activities: Complete configuration, validation and QA
Confirm segment targeting and pricing
Launch where feasible and monitor initial signals
Document decisions and follow-up actions

weeks.title: Performance monitoring
weeks.focus: Assess the initial commercial and player impact.
outcomes: Early results and key signals are documented
Performance is assessed against the agreed baseline
activities: Monitor revenue, conversion, payer behavior and engagement
Review segment-level performance
Check economy and player-experience guardrails
Identify anomalies, risks and unintended effects
Share an initial performance update

weeks.title: Optimization and learning
weeks.focus: Turn results into decisions and improvements.
outcomes: Key learnings are captured
Required changes or follow-up tests are defined
activities: Analyze uplift, cannibalization and longer-term implications
Collect feedback from cross-functional partners
Identify pricing, segmentation, creative or mechanic improvements
Recommend whether to scale, iterate, repeat or stop
Document the initiative post-mortem

weeks.title: Six-month monetization roadmap
weeks.focus: Prioritize the next set of monetization opportunities.
outcomes: Opportunity backlog is prioritized
A balanced six-month commercial roadmap is drafted
activities: Consolidate offer, feature, LiveOps, economy and process opportunities
Prioritize by impact, effort, readiness, player value and risk
Balance short-term revenue opportunities with longer-term improvements
Identify required experiments and foundational work
Align with Product, Economy, Analytics and LiveOps leadership

weeks.title: Operating model and 90-day review
weeks.focus: Establish sustainable monetization ownership and cross-functional routines.
outcomes: Monetization roadmap and operating model are agreed
Recurring performance and planning cadences are established
Role priorities for the next period are clear
activities: Present the six-month monetization roadmap
Confirm commercial-planning and performance-review cadences
Clarify initiative intake, prioritization, execution and measurement
Complete reflections, manager assessment and development priorities
